verification: Confirm SKick appears in the Antigravity skill inventory or is selected automatically for a matching low-risk prompt.

verification: Run /skills and confirm the installed/flattened SKick command is visible before relying on it.

augment.availability: Skill support is a host capability; Augment plan/usage limits and model-provider billing are separate from Skill discovery.

verification: Start BrowserCode (`bcode`) and verify SKick is visible/usable as a skill.
Run a low-risk browser-aware task and confirm SKick instructions are loaded before claiming successful installation.

verification: Confirm which agent/harness actually runs the model, then verify SKick in that host.

chatgpt.preferred_install: Upload canonical skill.zip through Plugins > Skills > Create > Upload from your computer.
verification: Confirm SKick appears in Skills as installed/enabled.
Run a low-risk prompt that clearly matches the SKick description.

Codex has separate Skill support and plan availability; do not infer Codex eligibility from the ChatGPT managed-Skill gate.

surfaces: Gemini Apps web/app surfaces that expose Skills
gemini-apps.preferred_install: Upload gemini-apps-skill.zip. This generated archive keeps SKILL.md at ZIP root and intentionally excludes PNG/binary assets because Gemini Apps Skills support plain-text skill files only.
verification: Confirm the Skill is visible/enabled in the Gemini Skills UI and run a low-risk trigger test.
gemini-apps.availability: Gemini Apps Skills are currently limited to Gemini Spark. Requirements include age 18+, a personal Google Account, Keep Activity on, and a qualifying Google AI subscription; work/school accounts are not supported. Geographic and subscription rules vary and can change.
limitations: Skills are a Gemini Spark feature, not a general Gemini chat feature.
Plain-text files are supported; binary/rich-media assets are excluded from the generated Gemini package.
Internet-dependent scripts are not supported in uploaded Skills.

managed_skill_upload.description: Web/desktop/mobile products that expose a native Skill upload/import UI.
managed_skill_upload.install_rule: Use the product UI. Do not invent filesystem paths or automate account actions that are not exposed.

native_agent_skill.description: Filesystem-capable agents that discover a skill directory containing SKILL.md.
native_agent_skill.install_rule: Prefer the runtime-specific path from the platform adapter. Preserve the full SKick directory and verify discovery.

shared_agent_skill.description: Agents that support the cross-client .agents/skills convention.
shared_agent_skill.install_rule: Use <project>/.agents/skills/skick or ~/.agents/skills/skick only when the host documents/scans the shared convention.

instruction_only.description: Agents with persistent rules/instructions but no verified Agent Skills loader.
instruction_only.install_rule: Use a runtime-specific instruction adapter or adapters/generic/PROMPT.md. Do not claim native progressive-loading skill behavior.

model_provider_only.description: LLM/provider/API/web surfaces where the model is hosted inside another agent or has no verified skill importer.
model_provider_only.install_rule: Route installation to the actual host runtime. If no host exists, use the generic prompt fallback.

custom_harness.install_rule: Implement Agent Skills discovery/activation per agentskills.io or load SKILL.md through a safe file/tool/prompt bridge.

browser_native_agent.description: Browser-first coding/research agents such as BrowserCode.
browser_native_agent.install_rule: Use the host coding-agent skill discovery path plus SKick web/browser validation guidance; browser capability does not replace skill installation.

fallback_chain: Use an exact first-party-verified runtime adapter when available.
If the runtime supports Agent Skills but no dedicated adapter exists, prefer its documented skill directory; if it documents .agents/skills, use that shared path.
If only persistent rules/instructions are supported, use adapters/generic/PROMPT.md or a runtime-specific instruction adapter.
If the target is only an LLM/model/API provider, install SKick in the actual host agent/harness rather than on the model name.
For a new/custom harness, implement Agent Skills discovery and progressive activation from SKILL.md according to agentskills.io/client-implementation/adding-skills-support.
If none of the above can be verified, do not fabricate a path. Ask for the runtime or use a one-session prompt import.

github_bootstrap.source_rule: Treat the GitHub repository as source transport; detect the actual host/runtime before installation.

serena.policy: The universal bootstrap prompt explicitly authorizes Serena setup only from canonical oraios/serena when repository engineering needs it and the active host supports it.
serena.fallback: Use the strongest host-native semantic/LSP/indexed repository capability and report the fallback when material.

verification: Validate package structure before install when local execution is appropriate.
Confirm the active runtime discovers SKick.
Run a low-risk trigger smoke test.
Report Serena availability/setup separately from SKick discovery.
